items.rationale: Clause 4.3(b) excludes the bicycle and its frame; 7.1.8(a) therefore excludes the entire replacement charge.
Bicycle braking assemblies are expressly excluded under 4.3(b), so none of the replacement charge is covered under 7.1.8(a).
The shipping relates solely to excluded property under 7.1.8(a); separately billed inbound delivery is also excluded under 7.1.8(d).
The workshop performed no covered work, so its vehicle charge is excluded under 7.1.8(a) and (f).
Clause 7.1.8(a) excludes all assembly and fitting directed at the uninsured bicycle.
The sundries were used solely on the excluded bicycle and are not covered under 7.1.8(a).
All labour grades are excluded under 7.1.8(a) when the work is directed at uninsured property, so the full hour is excluded.
All three hours served the bicycle repair and are excluded under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10.
Clause 7.1.7(g) covers one attendance by the locksmith for the insured back-door repair. Allow €70 gross for one local visit, with no deductible amount stated.

Clauses 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover fitting the replacement lock to the damaged door at the pre-loss standard. Allow €65 gross for the fitting if distinct from the separately billed hours; 7.1.8(g) bars duplicate labour.
Clauses 7.1.7(f) and 11.3 cover sundries incorporated into the insured door repair. Allow €20 gross for ordinary fixings and consumables.
Clauses 7.1.7(e) and 11.3 expressly cover apprentice labour on the insured repair. Allow one hour at €45 gross.
Clauses 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(e) cover skilled labour needed to restore the forced door's locking function. Allow one hour at €95 gross.
